explication: pi-skills is a collection of agent-invoked skills, not a single application: an agent selects a capability and runs its instructions or command-line helper to obtain results from an external service or browser. The README documents search, browser automation, Google Calendar/Drive/Gmail, transcription, VS Code, and YouTube transcript capabilities. Sampled code shows Brave search and extraction, several independent Chrome tools, Hacker News scraping, and transcript retrieval. Google, transcription, and VS Code implementations were not sampled; their nodes reflect README descriptions and skill paths only.
